_meta.what: Hand-curated datacenter-capacity registry for the KARTO nation axis. Per pilot finding P5/F4': per-country installed MW is NOT reliably in search snippets and the harvest returned compute_band=unknown ~10/10 twice. Retrieval was tried and failed; capacity is therefore hand-curated from named industry/energy sources, exactly like data/chokepoint-registry.json, and joined at build time.
_meta.figures_are_installed_it_power: Values are installed / operational IT power capacity (MW) as most recently reported. Bands: <10MW / 10-100MW / 100-1000MW / GW-scale. Where a country is unambiguously tens of GW (US), band=GW-scale even without a single tidy MW figure.
_meta.no_fabrication: Every entry carries the source that gave the figure. Countries with no sourced figure are simply absent (harvest keeps 'unknown').
_meta.maintenance: Capacity moves fast; re-check annually. as_of recorded per entry.

USA.note: Tens of GW; data centers = 4% of US electricity 2024. Largest market on earth.

CHN.note: ~32 GW installed end-2025, projected 40 GW end-2026.

IND.note: ~1.5 GW mid-2025, up from 375-520 MW in 2020 (gov PIB + CBRE).

FRA.note: 1,034 MW (France Datacenter); 700MW AI DC project planned.

KOR.note: ~591 MW across ~147 data centers, concentrated Greater Seoul.

SAU.note: 440 MW operational 2025 (from 68 MW in 2021); 2nd globally in market attractiveness.

ARE.note: ~358 MW current, set to ~950 MW by 2028 (+165%).

SGP.note: ~500+ MW; years-long moratorium, +300MW then +200MW allocation calls lifting it.

IRL.note: ~1,150 MW around Dublin; grid-constrained, moratorium pressure.

NLD.note: 924 MW total colocation capacity 2024 (Dutch Data Center Assoc).

DEU.note: Frankfurt (top-4 EU FLAP-D hub): 542MW under construction + 383 planned atop operational base; single NTT site 480MW.

MYS.note: Johor alone >1,500 MW (47 data centers); 850MW actual demand 2025.

BRA.note: ~700 MW total (São Paulo ~67% of it); +1,800MW pipeline.

CAN.note: ~337 MW AI data-centre capacity; 20+ GW in planned projects.
